desc:
Join CCMW LAW (Legal Advocacy for Women) for an engaging webinar exploring parenting and child support through both Canadian and Muslim family law frameworks, with practical insights to better support Muslim women navigating family law matters.

CPD Accreditation: 
1 hour Professionalism Content 
30 minutes EDI Professionalism Content 

This webinar is designed for lawyers, paralegals, social service providers, and Muslim women seeking to deepen their understanding of culturally competent legal practice.
title: Building Cultural Competency to Support Muslim Women
